Paragraph: Summary of Passage: Krishna selects Arjuna to receive this ancient yoga science because Arjuna is His dedicated devotee and friend, making him uniquely capable of grasping its deep mystery.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Identifying the qualifications necessary to comprehend deep spiritual and psychological truths.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna tells Arjuna: 'bhakto 'si me sakha ceti rahasyam hy etad uttamam' (You are My devotee and My friend; therefore you can understand this supreme mystery).
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna is formally chosen as the medium to re-introduce the sacred teachings to the world.
Mental_Health_Themes: Humility as a Gateway to Learning

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Receptivity and Trust: Opening oneself up to guidance through safe and trusting relationships
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Relational Wisdom Sharing: Learning deep truths within supportive, collaborative connections
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Humility as a Gateway to Learning: Dropping defensive cynicism to absorb life-changing insights

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Bhakto 'si me sakha ca (You are My devotee and My friend)
Rahasyam hy etad uttamam (This supreme and confidential mystery)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Krishna re-establishes the lost yoga with Arjuna because of their relationship of loving devotion and trust, proving that devotion opens access to divine secrets.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Deep personal insight cannot be forced through intellectual pride; it requires a trustful, open mindset and supportive relationships to be integrated effectively.
